job_description:
Junior Product Designer

We are looking for a junior product designer to support our design team. You will help with wireframes, prototypes, and usability testing under mentorship.

Requirements:
- Portfolio showing wireframes and prototypes
- Exposure to Figma and user research
- Eagerness to learn design systems and product design
notes: Product-design discipline at entry-level seniority; thin intern/coursework resume against a junior design JD. Second entry-level case, mid-low expected band.
